part.text: Now I have the schema. Both tables join on `team_api_id`. I'll compute the average `buildUpPlayPassing` in 2012 and find teams above it.

input.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT t.team_long_name
FROM Team t
JOIN Team_Attributes ta ON t.team_api_id = ta.team_api_id
WHERE strftime('%Y', ta.date) = '2012'
  AND ta.buildUpPlayPassing IS NOT NULL
  AND ta.buildUpPlayPassing > (
    SELECT SUM(ta2.buildUpPlayPassing) / COUNT(t2.team_long_name)
    FROM Team_Attributes ta2
    JOIN Team t2 ON ta2.team_api_id = t2.team_api_id
    WHERE strftime('%Y', ta2.date) = '2012'
      AND ta2.buildUpPlayPassing IS NOT NULL
  )
ORDER BY t.team_long_name
